states.errorBody: The request did not complete. Check the connection and try again.
states.noAccessTitle: Not found, or you don't have access
states.noAccessBody: This record does not exist, or it belongs to a facility you are not assigned to.
states.notFoundBody: This address does not match any page.

login.title: Staff sign in
login.failed: Sign-in failed. Check the connection and try again.
login.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
login.heroBody: A shared workspace for coordinators, nurses, ASHAs and doctors.
login.pointSharedPhone: Built for shared phones: one number never merges two people.
login.pointUnknown: Nothing is guessed: unknown stays unknown.
login.pointFacility: You see only the records of the facilities you work at.
login.subtitle: Sign in with the account your administrator gave you.

mothers.title: Mothers
mothers.description: Search by phone or name first. Register only if she is not found.

find.title: Find an existing mother
find.intro: Search only finds records at facilities you are assigned to. A shared phone number never merges people: each match is listed separately.
find.name: Name (partial matches)
find.needOneField: Enter a phone number, a name, or both.
find.emptyBody: No match in your facilities. If this mother is new here, use "Register new mother".
find.startBody: Search by phone, name or both. If the mother is not found, register her with "Register new mother".
find.matchHint: Check the name and age before choosing. A shared phone can belong to more than one person.

register.title: Register a mother and open a pregnancy episode
register.phoneHint: A phone number may be shared by more than one household member. It is never used as anyone's identity.
register.ageHint: Never guess. Choose "Unknown" rather than inventing a date.
register.history: Reported medical history (as told by the family, optional)
register.registeredPending: {{name}} is registered. Opening the pregnancy episode did not finish. Try again.
register.noFacilities: You are not assigned to any facility, so you cannot register a mother. Ask an administrator.

episode.title: Pregnancy episode
episode.motherLoadFailed: Could not load the mother's record.
episode.contactNotConfirmed: Not yet confirmed with the family (staff confirmation only; no OTP).
episode.reloadNote: This record is loaded from the server each time, so reloading the page shows what is saved.

age.notRecorded: Age / date of birth not recorded

guide.title: Before you start
guide.searchFirst: Search first. Register only if she is not found, so the same mother is never registered twice.
guide.sharedPhone: A phone can be shared by a family. Matches are never merged; check the name and age before choosing.
guide.unknown: If something is not known, choose "Unknown". Never guess a date or age.
guide.synthetic: Synthetic data only. Never enter a real person's details.

care.changedElsewhere: Someone else changed this record. It has been reloaded; please check and try again.
care.clinicianOnly: Only a clinician can do this.

dating.title: Pregnancy dating
dating.unknownBody: No date has been recorded. Nothing is assumed or calculated.
dating.needOneDate: Enter the last period date, the expected date, or both.
dating.lockedForNonClinician: A clinician has confirmed this dating. Only a clinician can correct it.
dating.correctNote: Correcting keeps past and attended visits as they are. Future visits timed by pregnancy week are cancelled and a review task is created to rebook them.
dating.evidenceSELF_REPORTED: Told by the mother or family

plan.title: Care plan
plan.none: No care plan has been published yet.
plan.noneNonClinician: A clinician publishes the care plan.
plan.placeholderWarning: Synthetic placeholder: not clinically approved. For demonstration only, never for real patients.
plan.replaceNote: Replacing cancels this plan's future, not-yet-attended items. Past and attended items are kept.
plan.unscheduled: Not scheduled yet (timed by pregnancy week; waiting for an approved rule): {{names}}
plan.noTemplates: No approved template is available for your organisation.

appt.title: Appointments
appt.empty: No appointments yet. Publishing a care plan creates them.
appt.missedNote: Marking missed creates one follow-up task for a named staff member.

today.title: Today
today.emptyMine: Nothing assigned to you right now.
today.emptyAll: No open tasks in your facilities.
today.note: "Overdue" means an administrative delay. It is never a clinical warning.
today.emptyBody: New tasks appear here when visits are missed, help is requested, or a plan needs follow-up.
today.emptyFiltered: No open tasks match this filter.

file.choose: File (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB)
file.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
file.wrongType: Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files can be uploaded.

reports.title: Tests and reports
reports.name: Test or report name
reports.reviewNote: Marking reviewed records that you, a clinician, have read this report. The app never reads or interprets it.

rx.title: Prescriptions
rx.noReminder: No reminder until a clinician confirms the instruction.
rx.transcription: Instruction exactly as written on the original
rx.transcriptionNote: Copy the words from the original. Do not change, shorten or add to them.
rx.unclearNote: No text and no reminder are kept. The review task stays open with you.

obs.title: Observations
obs.name: What was observed
obs.unapprovedList: The list of allowed observations and units is waiting for the doctor's approval (D05). Values are stored exactly as entered; nothing is compared or flagged.

ref.title: Referrals
ref.adviceNote: Recording advice creates one follow-up task for the owner.
ref.messageNote: Sending a message never closes a referral. Close it only with a recorded outcome or reason.

contacts.title: Local contacts
contacts.intro: Verified telephone contacts for local services. Check numbers before giving them to a family.
contacts.empty: No contacts yet for this facility.
contacts.addNote: Adding a contact records that you verified the number today.
contacts.name: Name

next.title: My next step
next.assistedNote: Use this screen together with the mother. Her answers are recorded as she gives them; staff confirmation is separate.
next.noneBody: Nothing has been confirmed with a date and place. Staff will confirm the next visit with you.
next.requestsWaiting_one: {{count}} visit is waiting to be confirmed.
next.requestsWaiting_other: {{count}} visits are waiting to be confirmed.
next.audioNotYet: Audio will be added once the message is approved.
next.helpCreated: A staff member has been asked to help.

birth.title: Birth plan
birth.birthPlace: Where she plans to give birth
birth.referralClinicianOnly: Only a clinician can choose the referral site.
birth.noContacts: No verified contacts yet. Add them on the Local contacts page first.
birth.verified: Verified with the family by {{name}} on {{date}}
birth.notVerified: Not yet gone through with the family
birth.verify: I went through this plan with the family
birth.changeClearsVerification: Saving changes clears the staff verification.
birth.noDispatch: This plan lists phone numbers and arrangements only. Nobody is sent automatically.
birth.printUrgent: If something feels wrong, call now. Urgent help page (no sign-in):

urgent.title: Urgent help
urgent.noContacts: No verified numbers are listed for this facility yet. Use the number on your printed plan.
urgent.noFacility: Open the urgent-help link printed on your birth plan, or call the number written on it.
urgent.loadFailed: This page could not load. Call the number on your printed birth plan.
urgent.wordingPending: Instructions on this page are waiting for a doctor's approval. Until then it lists verified phone numbers only.
urgent.hoursNotSet: Not yet confirmed by the facility.
urgent.noMonitoring: Messages to the support team are not watched for emergencies. In an emergency, call.
urgent.noLocation: This page does not use your location.

sample.tooltip: Invented sample data to show the planned screen. Not connected to real records.

overview.description: Open work across your facility, and the quickest ways to get to it.
overview.upNextBody: Grouped by mother: overdue first, then by due date.
overview.qaFindBody: Search first, so no one is registered twice
overview.qaUrgentBody: The public page printed on birth plans
overview.visitsBody: Attended and missed. Missed visits create an administrative follow-up.

landing.eyebrow: For maternal care teams in India
landing.body: MatriSathi is a shared workspace for coordinators, nurses, ASHAs and doctors to register mothers, keep visits on track, collect reports and plan for birth — on any phone.
landing.pilotNote: In development. The current environment uses synthetic data only.
landing.sketchCaption: Illustration of the staff workspace, with synthetic names
landing.featuresBody: Built around the everyday work of a facility, not around a form.

landing.principlesBody: Decisions that protect mothers and the staff who care for them.

messages.description: Family messages in one inbox, linked to the right mother's record.
messages.notice: Messaging is planned for a later phase. These conversations are invented examples; nothing is sent or received.
